routes.question: what wakes a read waiter after a leadership change
routes.why: group_view owns the sleeper slots and the published role and term; its wait bracket is what a role change wakes

routes.question: which code publishes a role or term change to handlers
routes.why: group_view owns the sequence-locked view (commit, applied, term, role, leader) that handlers copy

routes.question: handler keeps using a stale leader view
routes.why: host_view_get returns a coherent copy; after 64 odd sequence loads it waits on view_mu (K107)

routes.question: read request sleeps waiting for a quorum proof
routes.why: the read round and proof are part of the published view; the three waits have three predicates

routes.question: can a flush wait for a PUT that is still in flight
routes.why: put_win_wait returns 0, 1, EFS_ERR_BUSY at the earlier of its bound and the RPC deadline, or EFS_ERR_IO

routes.question: what closes a PUT window when the PUT fails
routes.why: every open is closed once on every exit; a close without an open is a caller error the owner does not detect

routes.question: reader blocked while a chunk PUT is in progress
routes.why: efs_dcache_put_win_wait is the reader wait; a close wakes it

routes.question: another user sees my find results
routes.why: find_res fetches first and serves the caller's own result; another uid or gid gets its own

routes.question: find query file reads old bytes after the search changed
routes.why: find_res_open answers -ESTALE when the bytes no longer match the interned version; a failed fetch never serves cached bytes

routes.question: fsync reports an old write error twice
routes.why: the sticky PUT error is returned once, by its own inode's drain or the global drain

routes.question: write call hangs when many writes are queued
routes.why: efs_wb_enqueue_owned answers EFS_ERR_BUSY when the ring stays full for 8 s or past the caller's deadline

routes.question: file closed but its lease is never released
routes.why: a retained last close counts as open until efs_open_release_pending sees the confirmed CLOSE

routes.question: open of a file answers busy while others hold it
routes.why: efs_open_acquire_fileid answers EFS_ERR_BUSY on a full admission, a late unknown OPEN or a contender on a held stripe
